title: Auditing Routing Entropy as an Uncertainty Signal in Attention-Residual Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.01495v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dynamic architectures leave a per-example routing trace beside each prediction, and diffuse routing is easy to read as a sign that the prediction is unreliable. We audit that reading for routing entropy in Attention-Residual (AR) variants of Swin-Tiny and DeiT-Small, trained from scratch on CIFAR-10/100 with a soft-binned calibration auxiliary loss, asking whether the trace carries information about correctness beyond what the model's own confidence already reveals. Three checks probe this increment: does a routing signal appear at fixed confidence, does it replicate across training seeds, and can a held-out predictor exploit it against output-only and shuffled-trace controls? A sensitivity audit then injects effects of known size and measures the fraction of each that the probes recover. No test in the fixed 30-test binned family survives multiplicity correction, and neither the nominal hit nor a borderline result recurs in its sibling

translated_title: 审计注意力-残差Transformer中的路由熵作为不确定性信号
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.01495v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：动态架构在每次预测旁边都会留下一个逐样本的路由轨迹，而弥散的路由很容易被解读为预测不可靠的迹象。我们对这一解读进行了审计，研究对象是在CIFAR-10/100上从零开始训练、带有软分箱校准辅助损失的Swin-Tiny和DeiT-Small的注意力-残差（AR）变体中的路由熵，探究该轨迹是否在模型自身置信度已经揭示的信息之外，还携带有关预测正确性的信息。三项检查用于探测这一增量：路由信号是否在固定置信度下出现、它是否在多个训练种子间可复现，以及一个留出预测器能否在“仅输出”和“打乱轨迹”的对照组之外利用该信号？随后的敏感性审计注入了已知大小的效应，并测量探针能够恢复其中多大的比例。在固定的30项检验分箱家族中，没有任何检验在经过多重性校正后仍然显著，而且无论是名义上的命中结果还是边缘性结果，在其兄弟模型中均未复现。
tldr: 本文审计了注意力-残差Transformer中路由熵能否在模型自身置信度之外额外指示预测的正确性，结果发现没有任何检验经多重性校正后仍显著，且结果无法跨随机种子和兄弟模型复现，表明路由熵并非可靠的不确定性信号。
en_tdlr: This paper audits routing entropy in Attention-Residual Transformers as an uncertainty signal and finds no evidence that it conveys information about prediction correctness beyond the model's own confidence, as no test survives multiplicity correction and neither the nominal hit nor a borderline result replicates across seeds or sibling architectures.
